name: list-packages
description: Discovers Composer and npm workspace packages and emits a JSON matrix array.

workdir.description: Working directory to search for packages. Defaults to the repository root.

filter.description: A jq `select()` boolean expression evaluated against each final package object (e.g. '.private == false', '.registry.npmjs.published == false'). Only packages for which it evaluates truthy are kept. Leave unset (default) to keep all packages.

require-repository.description: When 'true', drop packages whose repository is not defined before applying `filter`. Set to 'false' to keep packages without a repository.

packages.description: JSON array of package objects (org, name, path, repository, private, registry).
